Record notes

On-demand CLI and MCP gateway for seven ArtCraft creative apps, with one focused skill.

Version 0.2.3 includes 1 complete skill procedures. Full original gateway and workflow; provider binaries excluded.

Requirements: Python >=3.10; ArtCraft CLI for provider operations.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add artcraft-design-toolkit@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP keeps its portable manifest at the root and preserves the referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from a12727e05886910a5830485bab497e7cadabd8c0. SHA-256: 83fb1b134d12490f9b686089ce10a139adca9219f1856f513c26d20de847ee11.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
